operations.title: The theta-defined xi logarithmic derivative is Nevanlinna exactly when RH holds
operations.statement: For Xi(z)=xi(1/2+iz) defined by the theta integral, M=-Xi'/Xi is meromorphic Nevanlinna iff every Xi zero is real, equivalently RH. Under that positivity, Herglotz realization yields a self-adjoint compact-resolvent operator A with symmetric det_2(I-zA^-1)=Xi(z)/Xi(0). The remaining provenance gate is to identify this abstract realization with a source Mellin boundary map.
operations.scope: Unconditional equivalence and conditional determinant realization; no proof of RH or source boundary identification.

operations.title: Xi logarithmic-derivative Nevanlinna equivalence test
operations.description: Compare the symmetric canonical product with the Herglotz pole expansion, then compute the paired second-regularized determinant.
